text_block_list.text:
...I was just thinking, that happened 
during a summer just like this.

Yes, I remember now, it was something that 
happened at summer training camp.

The first time we spoke was also, just 
like today, on a clear, sunny beach early 
in the morning.

Back then, Air Messiah was just quietly 
sweating it out toward her goal, putting 
in the effort, step by step... steadily 
walking toward achieving it.

"I remember. That's the kind of girl she 
was, to me."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer.......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Um. What you wanted to discuss was—
choice_data_list: I want you to look at this.

text_block_list.text:
Saying so, I thump down the results of the 
'preparations' that ultimately took all 
night to finish.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...!? Th-That's an incredible stack of 
papers. What on earth are they...?

A bewildered Air Messiah's gaze caught the 
text at the very top of the stack of 
papers... in other words, the "cover."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“The Basis for Air Messiah's Inevitable 
Victory in the Shuka Sho” Japan Umamusume 
Training Center Academy <username>...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Could this possibly be...?
choice_data_list:
I just wanted to dispel any doubts you 
had.

I wanted to clear away the doubts inside 
you.

text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't say anything witty. I'm 
just not clever enough for that.

"It has always been that way. All they 
possessed was an astonishing degree of 
earnestness and sheer single-mindedness."

However, even so—I was taught to hold my 
head high, look forward, and see things 
through to the end.
choice_data_list: I wrote a whole paper about you!!
I wrote a thesis about you!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ................A research paper.

The theme is just as the title on the 
cover says: "Definitive Proof of Air 
Messiah's Inevitable Victory in the Shuka 
Sho."

I had mountains of data right at hand, 
more than enough to back up my thesis.

"Skill Chart Analysis_62." "Training 
Schedule_89." "Rival Data Analysis_78."

Countless discussions, countless 
revisions. Each numbered file in the old 
folder marked another step of their shared 
journey.

So I can provide as much proof as you 
need.

"Therefore, the probability of Air 
Messiah's victory in the Shuka Sho is 
exceptionally high."
choice_data_list:
I have more than enough proof to say that 
with confidence!

text_block_list.text:
After that, Air Messiah took her time to 
read through the entire thick thesis for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...So many graphs trending upward.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...Isn't this analysis a bit too much 
wishful thinking? The way this data is 
interpreted feels a little overly 
optimistic, too.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Even so, ...—I can feel it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(From the sterile, printed Mincho font, 
from the simple charts with barely any 
color)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Your feelings...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much. I have read 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry about that... It was quite thick 
and heavy.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Just a slight pain.
choice_data_list:
What!? W-We need to cool it down 
immediately...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's really nothing that big of a 
deal—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: F-Fufu... Fufufu...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufu...! I-I'm sorry. ...Honestly, 
it was just beyond my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You are far more serious... than I had 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly surprised. ...I wonder if this 
is the first time I've felt 'outdone' in 
this sort of thing."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've never heard of such a thing. 
Writing a research paper just to encourage 
your trainee Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even I can't help but feel that... 'Isn't 
this just a bit too stiff and formal?'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...That is precisely why, to me, it was 
the most powerful encouragement I could 
have asked for."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The more I doubted, the more I desperately 
wanted to believe. And thanks to you, I 
was able to believe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—It really hasn't changed. And I'm sure it 
never will.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Being sound. Being steady. Simply piling 
on effort with stubborn honesty.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Inherited from my beloved mother—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And together with you, I have polished it 
to perfection. This one-and-only 
"strength."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...To make everyone convinced of it. 
To prove it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: At the Shuka Sho, I will win without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I will accomplish it, without fail. I'm 
sure everything will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Because it's backed by solid evidence.

Air Messiah smiles brightly. Her sheer 
nobility takes my breath away.

It was all right now. Everything was all 
right. The crisp morning air, the gentle 
sound of the tide— it felt as though 
everything was blessing her.
